title: Games as Dreams: Using Symbolic Archetypes to Craft Powerful, Flexible Narratives
description: It's every Narrative Designer's worst nightmare. A quest has been cut, an enemy descoped, or a character nixed. The game narrative makes no sense anymore! This session will explain and explore a tool to help in this situation and many more: “Dream Mode”. By using symbolic archetypes, like the kind we encounter in dreams, we can turn overwhelming narrative complexity and confusion into functional building blocks that can quickly be adapted.
session_takeaway: How to use 'Dream Mode' to transform a complex narrative into its symbolic and functional core.
How to distill characters, locations, and beats into symbolic, highly flexible archetypes.
How to work with these building blocks to rapidly adapt a narrative when design shifts occur.
prompt: Build an interactive, animated comic book. The panels should animate as the user clicks, telling a dramatic, over-the-top story about 'Games as Dreams: Using Symbolic Archetypes to Craft Powerful Flexible Narratives' and the struggles of: 'It's every Narrative Designer's worst nightmare'.
